component.name: Badge
component.description: A small, non-interactive text label that tags content with a short category or status (e.g. a course topic). Text only — no icon, not clickable. Two looks: outline (default) and filled.
component.figmaNodeId: none — no Figma component set exists

when: Tagging a course or piece of content with its topic or category
Showing a short, static status next to content

patterns.name: topic-tags
patterns.description: A row of Badges listing a course's topics, wrapping on narrow viewports.

antiPatterns.scenario: Making a Badge clickable or using it as a filter toggle
antiPatterns.reason: Badge is a static label; onClick is excluded from its props and it has no focus or pressed state.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Chip for filter toggles, TextLink for navigation.

antiPatterns.scenario: Adding an icon inside a Badge
antiPatterns.reason: Badge is text only by design.
antiPatterns.alternative: Compose Icon and Text in an Inline next to the content instead.

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering the label text with a raw string style or overriding its color
antiPatterns.reason: Badge renders its children through <Text as="span" size="body-small" color="subtle">; the color prop is excluded.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass plain text as children and pick the look with variant.

purpose.outline: Transparent background with a subtle border. The default look.
purpose.filled: Faint neutral fill inside the same subtle border, for a little more visual weight than outline.
